bikrost_xpp_10m_desc: Fiberglass-based underlay and vapor barrier material.
bikrost_xpp_10m_modal: Bikrost XPP consists of a double-sided bitumen coating on a fiberglass base, primarily intended as an underlayer for roofing and as a vapor barrier. This 10-meter roll material is easily installed on the surface by heating with a gas torch and ensures resistance to mechanical impacts.
bikrost_xpp_15m_modal: Bikrost XPP with a length of 15 meters provides the advantage of cost-effective and continuous installation in large-scale buildings. The fiberglass base gives the material optimal lightness and excellent vapor barrier properties, allowing it to be widely used in industrial and civil construction.
bikrost_xpp_tpp_10m_desc: High-strength underlay insulation based on fiberglass fabric.
bikrost_xpp_tpp_10m_modal: Bikrost TPP is prepared on a reinforced fiberglass fabric base, showing high resistance to tensile and tearing forces. Classified under code 6807100000, this 10-meter roll is used as a reliable underlayer protector in roofing systems and foundation insulation.
bikrost_tkp_10m_desc: Top-layer roof insulation with a sandy protective surface.
bikrost_tkp_10m_modal: Since the upper surface of the Bikrost TKP material is covered with a layer of coarse-grained granules (sand), it offers excellent resistance to ultraviolet solar rays and direct atmospheric influences. Thanks to its fiberglass fabric base, it is long-lasting and reliably protects the top coating of the roof even in harsh weather conditions.
linokrom_tpp_10m_modal: Linokrom TPP is a premium-class insulation material distinguished by its high-quality bitumen-polymer composition and strong fiberglass fabric base. This 10-meter roll ensures maximum performance and a long service life under harsh climatic conditions to protect building structures from moisture and water.
linokrom_epp_10m_desc: Polyester-based flexible and durable insulation roll.
linokrom_epp_10m_modal: Linokrom EPP demonstrates high flexibility against various levels of deformations and building movements thanks to the elastic polyester fiber forming its base. Covered with protective film on both sides, this 10-meter material creates perfect adhesion and sealing even on complex-shaped surfaces.
unifleks_tpp_10m_modal: Unifleks TPP maintains its flexibility even in harsh climatic conditions thanks to its high-quality SBS (styrene-butadiene-styrene) elastomer-modified bitumen composition and strong fiberglass base. This 10-meter roll material is easily installed even at challenging temperatures and provides reliable underlayer protection in roofing systems and foundations.
unifleks_epp_10m_desc: Polyester-based highly flexible and deformation-resistant insulation.
unifleks_epp_10m_modal: The strong polyester mesh forming the base of the Unifleks EPP material grants high tensile resistance and flexibility against movements and stresses that may occur in building structures. Covered with polymer film on both sides, this 10-meter roll perfectly adapts to any complex surface, creating long-lasting waterproofing.
unifleks_tkp_10m_desc: SBS-modified top-layer roof covering with a sandy protective layer.
unifleks_tkp_10m_modal: Unifleks TKP features a special coarse-grained granule (sand) surface resistant to ultraviolet solar rays and atmospheric effects. Installed on a fiberglass fabric framework, this 10-meter top-layer material protects the building roof from mechanical damage and moisture, ensuring trouble-free operation for many years.
texnoelast_ekp_10m_modal: Texnoelast EKP is a premium-class bitumen-polymer material designed for the most severe operating conditions and freezing climates. Thanks to its highly flexible polyester base and protective surface granules, it exhibits maximum durability and lifespan even on the highest and most complex industrial building roofs.
texnoelast_tkp_10m_modal: Texnoelast TKP material possesses exceptional resistance to tearing forces and mechanical loads thanks to its strong fiberglass fabric framework and specially modified bitumen composition. With its 10-meter roll format and protective surface layer, it fully meets the insulation needs of the most demanding construction projects.
texnoelast_epp_10m_desc: Elastic polyester-based universal under and intermediate layer insulation.
texnoelast_epp_10m_modal: Texnoelast EPP stands out with its high tensile capacity polyester base and perfectly absorbs dynamic loads in building structural elements. Acting as a reliable under or intermediate layer in multilayer insulation systems, it creates an impermeable barrier against water and moisture.
stekloizol_xpp_2.1mm_9m_desc: Economy-class fiberglass-based lightweight vapor and waterproofing.
stekloizol_xpp_2.1mm_9m_modal: Stekloizol XPP 2.1 mm is an oxidized bitumen-composed underlayer material with an economical price-quality ratio, installed on a fiberglass base. This light 9-meter roll is effectively used as a primary vapor barrier in roofing structures and sub-foundation insulation works.
stekloizol_tpp_2.1mm_9m_modal: Stekloizol TPP 2.1 mm shows higher resistance to tearing and tensile forces compared to standard insulation materials, thanks to its fiberglass fabric framework base. With its 9-meter roll format, it perfectly adapts as a foundational protective layer for multilayer roof coverings in civil and industrial construction.
stekloizol_xpp_2.5mm_9m_desc: Increased thickness fiberglass-based underlayer waterproofing roll.
stekloizol_xpp_2.5mm_9m_modal: Stekloizol XPP 2.5 mm model features a thicker bitumen layer, significantly strengthening the surface's resistance to moisture and water. Its fiberglass base gives stability to the material, while its 9-meter size ensures comfortable transport and ease of application at construction sites.
stekloizol_tpp_2.5mm_9m_desc: Reinforced fiberglass-based 2.5 mm thick underlayer insulation.
stekloizol_tpp_2.5mm_9m_modal: Stekloizol TPP 2.5 mm combines the mechanical strength provided by its fiberglass fabric base and the reliable sealing created by its increased 2.5 mm thickness. It acts as a reliable underlayer on roof surfaces exposed to medium and heavy loads, as well as in the insulation of underground structures.
stekloizol_r_tpp_3.0_15m_modal: Stekloizol R TPP 3.0 is a high-performance material manufactured specifically in a 15-meter length, minimizing joint locations in large-area projects. Thanks to its 3 mm thickness and strong fiberglass framework, it ensures a fast, cost-effective, and reliable insulation process in industrial facilities.
stekloizol_r_xpp_3.0_15m_desc: 15-meter fiberglass-based roll designed for large areas.
stekloizol_r_xpp_3.0_15m_modal: Stekloizol R XPP 3.0 features a long 15-meter format that allows saving time and material in large-scale construction and repair works. With its fiberglass-based structure and optimal 3 mm bitumen thickness, it is an advantageous and long-lasting solution for vapor and moisture insulation of large roofs.
stekloizol_tkp_10m_desc: Protective surface fiberglass-based top-layer roof covering.
stekloizol_tkp_10m_modal: Stekloizol TKP is a reliable top-layer insulation material with a fiberglass framework base, whose surface is covered with a layer of coarse-grained granules (sand). By showing high resistance to negative effects of solar rays and atmospheric precipitation, it extends the lifespan of the roofing and provides maximum protection with an economical budget.
texnofas_1200_600_100mm_desc: Stone wool-based 100 mm thick facade insulation board.
texnofas_1200_600_100mm_modal: The Texnofas 1200x600x100 mm stone wool board is specifically designed for external facade insulation using ETICS (plastered facade systems). Alongside high thermal and sound insulation properties, its non-combustibility ensures maximum fire safety in buildings.
texnofas_1200_600_50mm_desc: Standard size and optimal density facade stone wool.
texnofas_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnofas 1200x600x50 mm boards are an ideal choice for the thermal insulation layer of external walls. Thanks to its optimal density, it perfectly supports applied plaster and paint layers, significantly reducing the building's heat loss indicators.
texnofas_1200_600_30mm_desc: Thin profile stone wool for facade insulation.
texnofas_1200_600_30mm_modal: The Texnofas 30 mm thick stone wool board provides effective thermal and sound protection without adding weight in confined spaces or special architectural details requiring additional insulation.
texnofas_dekor_1200_600_50mm_desc: Stone wool for decorative elements and complex facade sections.
texnofas_dekor_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnofas Dekor 1200x600x50 mm is specially optimized for easy handling and the application of aesthetic details during the insulation of windowsills, cornices, and other architectural elements of facades.
texnofas_ekstra_1200_600_50mm_desc: High strength and density premium facade stone wool.
texnofas_ekstra_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnofas Ekstra 1200x600x50 mm features enhanced physical and mechanical indicators. Due to its high level of tensile and compressive resistance, it delivers flawless results in heavy-duty facade insulation systems of high-rise buildings.
texnofas_optima_1200_600_50mm_desc: Cost-effective and balanced facade stone wool.
texnofas_optima_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnofas Optima 1200x600x50 mm is a reliable thermal and sound insulation material designed for standard civil construction projects, maintaining a balance between price and quality. It ensures long-lasting performance on facade surfaces.
texnofas_optima_1200_600_80mm_desc: Increased thickness economical facade insulation board.
texnofas_optima_1200_600_80mm_modal: Texnofas Optima with its 80 mm thickness is a stone wool solution that meets energy efficiency requirements, creating a budget-friendly and effective thermal barrier. It plays a crucial role in protecting exterior walls from cold air currents.
texnofas_effekt_1200_600_50mm_desc: Enhanced performance facade insulation stone wool.
texnofas_effekt_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnofas Effekt 1200x600x50 mm possesses a low thermal conductivity coefficient and enhanced moisture resistance thanks to its special fiber structure. Fully meeting modern construction standards, it extends the lifespan of facades.
texnofas_optima_1200_600_80mm_6806100000: Economical facade insulation stone wool with Code 6806100000.

Texnofas Optima 80 mm thickness (Code: 6806100000) is a balanced and affordable stone wool material intended for external facade thermal insulation. It increases energy efficiency by reducing heat loss in buildings.
texnovent_ekstra_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnovent Ekstra 1200x600x50 mm is specifically developed for suspended and ventilated facade systems. It stands out with its air-flow resistant surface and high density.
texnovent_ekstra_1200_600_100mm_desc: 100 mm thick ventilated facade insulation board.
texnovent_ekstra_1200_600_100mm_modal: Texnovent Ekstra 1200x600x100 mm is a heavy-duty, industrial-type stone wool that minimizes building heat loss in ventilated facades and is completely fire-safe.
texnovent_optima_1200_600_50mm_desc: Economical ventilated facade insulation stone wool.
texnovent_optima_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnovent Optima 1200x600x50 mm is a cost-effective and balanced thermal insulation product intended for ventilated facade systems.
texnovent_optima_1200_600_80mm_desc: 80 mm thick economical ventilated facade insulation.
texnovent_optima_1200_600_80mm_modal: Texnovent Optima 1200x600x80 mm is a reliable stone wool board providing optimal thermal protection and a budget-friendly solution in ventilated facades.
texnovent_optima_1200_600_100mm_modal: Texnovent Optima 1200x600x100 mm is a long-lasting and durable stone wool plate fully meeting thermal insulation requirements in ventilated facade projects.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_5800_1220_50_des: Rolled fiberglass-based sound and thermal insulation mat.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_5800_1220_50_mod: IZOBOKS 44 R Teplozashita (5800x1220x50 mm / Fito) is a roll-shaped mineral wool (fiberglass) product specifically designed to provide sound and thermal insulation in lightweight frame structures, ceilings, and horizontal surfaces. It is distinguished by ease of installation and high insulation capacity.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_6250_1220_50_des: Extended format rolled sound and thermal insulation.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_6250_1220_50_mod: IZOBOKS 44 R Teplozashita 6250x1220x50 mm rolled insulation mat provides fast and effective thermal-sound protection by creating fewer joint locations over large areas. It has an eco-friendly structure.
texnonikol_44rn_teplaya_daca_desc: 15.25 m² rolled insulation for country houses and lightweight structures.
texnonikol_44rn_teplaya_daca_modal: Technonicol 44 RN Teplaya Dacha (6250x1220x50 mm / Fito / 1 roll = 15.25 m²) is specifically intended for country houses, mansards, and lightweight framed structures. It prevents energy loss by creating an ideal thermal barrier on surfaces.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_mini_desc: MINI format rolled insulation for narrow and complex areas.
izoboks_44r_teplozasita_mini_modal: IZOBOKS 44 R Teplozashita MINI (6560x610x50 mm / Fito) is a sound and thermal insulation material designed to be comfortably applied in confined spaces, narrow frame gaps, and special repair works thanks to its compact width dimension.
ralu_banya_i_sauna_desc: Foil-coated 15 m² thermal insulation for baths and saunas.
ralu_banya_i_sauna_modal: 40 RAlu Banya i Sauna (12500x1200x50 mm / Fito / 1 roll = 15.0 m²) is a special insulation mat coated on one side with aluminum foil. It simultaneously ensures the reflection of heat back and complete protection against moisture in baths, saunas, and high-humidity rooms.
izoboks_extralayt_100mm_desc: 3.84 m² area 100 mm thick lightweight insulation board.
izoboks_extralayt_100mm_modal: IZOBOKS EXTRALIGHT 100 mm (3.84 m²) is a high-quality mineral wool board intended for frame walls, ceilings, and non-load-bearing horizontal structures. It stands out with excellent sound absorption and heat retention properties.
cat_texnoakustik: For Acoustics and Walls (Sound and Thermal)
texnoakustik_1200_600_50mm_desc: High sound insulation stone wool board.
texnoakustik_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnoakustik 1200x600x50 mm boards are prepared in a special fiber structure to maximize the sound insulation of internal walls, partitions, and ceilings. It creates a comfortable acoustic environment by preventing external noises in homes and offices.
texnoakustik_1200_600_100mm_desc: Reinforced sound and thermal insulation 100 mm stone wool.
texnoakustik_1200_600_100mm_modal: Texnoakustik 1200x600x100 mm flawlessly ensures sound absorption and insulation in noisy environments thanks to its increased thickness. It also exhibits high performance as an additional thermal insulation layer.
roklait_rosklite_1200_600_50mm_desc: Universal stone wool for lightweight buildings and attics.
roklait_rosklite_1200_600_50mm_modal: Roklait (Rosklite) 1200x600x50 mm is a lightweight, eco-friendly, and efficient thermal-sound insulation material ideal for private houses, attics, frame walls, and non-load-bearing horizontal surfaces.
roklait_rosklite_1200_600_100mm_desc: 100 mm thick lightweight frame insulation stone wool.
roklait_rosklite_1200_600_100mm_modal: Roklait (Rosklite) 1200x600x100 mm creates a strong thermal barrier against cold air currents in residential houses and other lightweight construction structures due to its increased thickness.
texnoblok_standart_1200_600_50mm_desc: Stone wool for universal frame walls and attics.
texnoblok_standart_1200_600_50mm_modal: Texnoblok Standart 1200x600x50 mm is a universal and reliable insulation material used for thermal and sound insulation purposes in frame structures, mansards, and triple-sided wall systems.
texnoblok_standart_1200_600_100mm_desc: Thickened universal frame and wall insulation.
texnoblok_standart_1200_600_100mm_modal: Texnoblok Standart 1200x600x100 mm boards provide maximum protection in construction areas requiring high thermal resistance, including attic and interior wall insulation.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1200_600_20l_desc: Extruded polystyrene (XPS) thermal insulation with Code 3921110000.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1200_600_20l_modal: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1200x600x20 mm (L-edge / Code: 3921110000) is an extruded polystyrene (XPS) board with high strength and minimal water absorption capacity. It is applied to prevent heat loss in flooring, balconies, and various surface insulations where a thin profile is required.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_30l_desc: 30 mm thick XPS thermal insulation board with L-edge.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_30l_modal: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1180x580x30 mm completely eliminates the formation of thermal bridges from joints during installation thanks to its edge lock (L) connection. It demonstrates high effectiveness especially in floor, foundation, and sub-facade insulations.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_40l_desc: 40 mm thick locked extruded polystyrene insulation.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_40l_modal: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1180x580x40 mm boards feature increased compressive strength and excellent thermal insulation parameters. The side L-lock profile increases installation speed and creates a reliable barrier against moisture by preserving surface integrity.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_50l_desc: Universal and most demanded 50 mm XPS insulation board.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_50l_modal: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1180x580x50 mm is an optimally thick XPS material widely used in construction. It stands out with exceptional resistance to heavy mechanical loads and frost, preserving buildings' thermal efficiency for many years.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_80l_desc: High thermal resistance 80 mm thick XPS board.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_80l_modal: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1180x580x80 mm provides maximum energy saving in harsh climatic conditions and underground structures, foundations, and flat roofs requiring strong thermal insulation due to its increased thickness.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_100l_desc: Maximum insulation capacity 100 mm thick XPS layer.
texnonikol_carbon_eco_1180_580_100l_moda: Technonicol Carbon ECO 1180x580x100 mm (with L-lock) is designed for the heaviest operating conditions and high energy efficiency standards. With its non-compressible structure and unique thermal impermeability, it is indispensable in civil and industrial construction.
praymer_bitumniy_aquamast_18l_desc: Bituminous primer for priming surfaces prior to insulation.
praymer_bitumniy_aquamast_18l_modal: AquaMast bituminous primer (18 l / Code: 2715000000) consists of a solution of high-quality petroleum bitumens in organic solvents. It is applied to the surface to maximize the adhesion capacity of concrete surfaces, cement-sand screeds, and roofing materials with insulation materials, dries quickly, and prevents dust formation.
mastika_bitumniya_aquamast_3kg_desc: Universal bitumen-based sealing and bonding mastic.
mastika_bitumniya_aquamast_3kg_modal: AquaMast bituminous mastic (3 kg / Code: 2715000000) is intended for roof repair, filling small cracks, and waterproofing various building elements. It has excellent adhesion strength, maintains its flexibility, and creates a reliable barrier against moisture.
praymer_ekonom_21.5l_desc: Cost-effective bitumen primer for large-scale constructions.
praymer_ekonom_21.5l_modal: Econom class bituminous primer (21.5 l) is an ideal solution for optimizing costs during the pre-waterproofing preparation process of large-area surfaces. By deeply penetrating concrete and other porous surfaces, it ensures that subsequent insulation layers bind firmly with the bottom base.
samarskiy_praymer_bitumniy_15kg_desc: Professional grade standard bituminous surface primer.
samarskiy_praymer_bitumniy_15kg_modal: Samarskiy bituminous primer (15 kg / Code: 2715000000) is a reliable primer material distinguished by its proven quality in industrial and civil construction. Used in surface preparation, it increases adhesion quality and gives a strong boost to the overall durability of roof and foundation insulation systems.
mastika_mbk_q_30kg_desc: Construction-type hot-applied bitumen mastic in a kraft bag.
mastika_mbk_q_30kg_modal: MBK-G type bitumen mastic (30 kg kraft bag / Code: 2715000000) is a traditional and strong material applied primarily by heating, used for heavy-duty waterproofing and roofing work. It forms a monolithic protective layer resistant to harsh weather conditions and mechanical impacts.
yanmaz_menbran_isomax_desc: Industrial-type membrane with high fire resistance.
yanmaz_menbran_isomax_modal: ISOMAX fireproof membrane (m² / Code: 7019590000) is a modern insulation product produced with special technology, resistant to flame and high temperature. In addition to increasing fire safety in buildings, it acts as an effective barrier against airflow and moisture.
suse_setka_psv_160gr_desc: Reinforcing fiberglass mesh for facade and insulation systems.
suse_setka_psv_160gr_modal: PSV brand 160-gram fiberglass mesh (m² / Code: 7019590000) is a reinforcing element applied in exterior facade insulation systems (ETICS) and plastering works to prevent the formation of cracks. It is resistant to alkaline environments and significantly increases the mechanical strength of the surface.
metal_dubel_izm_10x160_desc: Metal-cored wall dowel for facade insulation systems.
metal_dubel_izm_10x160_modal: 10x160 size metal dowel (IZM / Code: 7317001000) is used to mechanically and securely fasten insulation boards (stone wool, expanded polystyrene, etc.) to various wall surfaces (concrete, brick). Thanks to its metal nail tip, it ensures maximum durability against heavy loads and stable fastening.

about.mainTitle: Protecting the Future of Buildings with Reliable Insulation
about.leadText: We offer high-quality insulation products that protect your living and working spaces from moisture, noise, and energy loss.
about.simulatorDesc: We extend the lifespan of structures with our advanced insulation materials that protect your buildings from harsh external influences. Our technology has the power to create an ideal environment in every season. Whether it is the harsh frost of winter or the scorching heat of summer, our materials provide the thermal balance and comfort you desire. For us, quality is not just about protection; it is also about the safety and energy efficiency of your building. The products we provide allow you to save on costs by preventing heat loss.
